Subject: Need help with a breach of contract case

Hello, my name is Divya Qureshi. I am a 62-year-old general physician living in Kochi. Our company has a breach of contract claim of ₹17,35,00,000 against Coastal Industries, and the goods supplied were defective. My case number is CS(COMM) 1469/2020 in the Kochi Commercial Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 08013563997 or email divya.qureshi@example.in.
